Beta prior from expert quantiles

expert_beta_prior.Rd

Fits the CDF on the log-odds scale so small target quantiles can be calibrated accurately.

Usage

expert_beta_prior(
  q,
  p = c(0.1, 0.9),
  start = NULL,
  method = "BFGS",
  maxit = 2000,
  tol = 1e-06
)

Arguments

q

Two increasing target quantiles in (0, 1).

p

Two increasing cumulative probabilities for q, in (0, 1).

start

Optional starting values for log(shape1), log(shape2).

method

Optimisation method passed to optim().

maxit

Maximum iterations for optim().

tol

Maximum tolerated absolute probability error at either target. A larger error triggers a warning regardless of the optimizer status.

Value

A bf_prior with dist = "beta". Its metadata includes the requested and achieved quantiles and probabilities, maximum probability error, and optimizer convergence code.

Examples

expert_beta_prior(q = c(0.02, 0.08), p = c(0.1, 0.9))
#> fermi prior
#>   Distribution: beta 
#>   Source      : expert 
#>   Parameters  :
#> $shape1
#> [1] 3.623528
#> 
#> $shape2
#> [1] 72.77062
#> 
#>   Quantile calibration:
#>  quantile requested_probability achieved_probability
#>      0.02                   0.1                  0.1
#>      0.08                   0.9                  0.9
expert_beta_prior(q = c(1e-6, 8e-6), p = c(0.025, 0.9))
#> fermi prior
#>   Distribution: beta 
#>   Source      : expert 
#>   Parameters  :
#> $shape1
#> [1] 3.175159
#> 
#> $shape2
#> [1] 695559.8
#> 
#>   Quantile calibration:
#>  quantile requested_probability achieved_probability
#>     1e-06                 0.025                0.025
#>     8e-06                 0.900                0.900
